newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Noel SA to issue ADRs, debt.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Noel SA to issue ADRs, debt.

text.p: Colombia's largest food manufacturer Industrias Alimenticias Noel SA is to issue ADRs and an additional 50 billion pesos in bonds to the domestic market, stock brokers linked to the company said Wednesday.
The move was approved at a shareholders meeting Tuesday in which the board of directors was empowered to plan where and what amount of ADRs would be placed.

Noel, is part of the powerful Medellin-based Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate. Compania Nacional de Chocolates, also part of the Sindicato, has a 33.3 percent stake in Noel, which according to the last available figures has assets of 300 billion pesos.

A spokesman for the Suvalor brokerage, which is also part of the Sindicato Antioqueno, said the decision to issue ADRs and domestic bonds was an effort to refinance debts of more than 78 billion pesos as of December 31 last year.
He said current debt levels were manageable, but that the move should cut the cost of financing the debt, estimated at about 13 billion pesos per year at present.
